Increasing Ad Cost

It’s tempting to rely on paid ads to keep customers flowing in. It feels like a sure bet—spend money, get traffic. But as competition heats up, the costs skyrocket. You keep paying more without seeing proportionate returns.

It’s tempting to rely on paid ads to keep customers flowing in. It feels like a sure bet—spend money, get traffic. But as competition heats up, the costs skyrocket. You keep paying more without seeing proportionate returns.

Low Conversion

It’s easy to get traffic, but turning visitors into buyers is another story. Many brands accept low conversion rates, thinking they’ll eventually improve.

It’s easy to get traffic, but turning visitors into buyers is another story. Many brands accept low conversion rates, thinking they’ll eventually improve.

Low LTV
